title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines. Start the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0187). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.0187) to (0.0, 0.0187), and finish the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0187) back to the origin. Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translate it using the translation vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0039 units in the direction of the normal to create a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular base for the cylinder are 0.75 units in length, 0.0187 units in width, and 0.0039 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0187) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0187) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0039)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
